applies_to: entire implant (single body, single material; no grading)

E_MPa.source: Formlabs Tough 1000 Resin product page, tech specs, 'Tensile Modulus 932.0 MPa' (https://formlabs.com/store/materials/tough-1000-resin/); footnote: parts printed on Form 4, 100 um, Tough 1000 Resin settings, post-cured with a Form Cure V2 for 12 minutes at 70 °C. TDS: https://formlabs.com/materials/data-sheets/?product=tough1000

nu.basis: assumed; Formlabs publishes no Poisson's ratio for its Tough resins. This is the same assumption the judge makes for its Tough 1500 and Rigid 10K entries
nu.source: EVAL_SPEC_v1.md §5 reference table (Tough 1500 V2 and Rigid 10K rows: nu 0.35 assumed), applied to the sister resin Tough 1000

strength_MPa.source: Formlabs Tough 1000 Resin product page, tech specs, 'Ultimate Tensile Strength 26.3 MPa' (https://formlabs.com/store/materials/tough-1000-resin/); same footnote (Form 4, 100 um, Form Cure V2 12 min at 70 °C)

elongation_at_break_pct.source: Formlabs Tough 1000 Resin product page, tech specs, 'Elongation at Break 180.0 %'
elongation_at_break_pct.note: informational; a ductile resin supports damage tolerance (G3)

flexural_modulus_MPa.source: Formlabs Tough 1000 Resin product page, tech specs, 'Flexural Modulus 761.0 MPa'
flexural_modulus_MPa.note: informational only; not used by the judge

print_settings.post_cure: Form Cure V2, 12 min, 70 °C (matches the datasheet footnote)

caveats: These are datasheet values. Tonight's Breakerspace tests did not include Tough 1000. The crosshead-measured Tough 1500 modulus was 22% below its datasheet value (1136 vs 1460 MPa), so the as-printed Tough 1000 modulus may also come in lower.
Poisson's ratio is assumed, not measured.
why_this_material: It is the lowest-modulus grounded resin with adequate strength. Its E (932 MPa) sits between bone C11 (245) and C33 (796), about 1.17x bone C33; Tough 1500 is 1.4-1.8x and PEEK about 5x. Its strength/E ratio (2.8%) is about the same as Tough 1500's (3.0%), so the G1 margin does not change.
